headline: Twelve replies, one booked. The month's cash is EUR 0 and the constraint is booking, not volume.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Work the reply queue before anything else. sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Booking rate, MEASURED 8.3 percent (1 of 12) against the 35 percent baseline. Eleven open replies owe roughly 4 booked calls at baseline. Second watch item: the Aug 3 note about account problems; volume is averaging 71 a day against 100.
